llm_response: This experiment underperformed compared to the previous best, with a ROC AUC drop of ~0.027. The simpler 4-conv architecture likely lacked the capacity of the previous 5-conv deep CNN with residual connections. The reduction in mixup from 0.5 to 0.2 may have decreased regularization effectiveness. The SE attention and BatchNorm were retained, suggesting they helped, but the network depth was reduced. Next experiment should increase model complexity by adding more conv layers or residual blocks, while maintaining or increasing mixup rate to 0.5. Consider using the 5-conv architecture from the previous best as a baseline.
